svg.title: Conway Twitty's Game of Life — seeded from my contribution graph
svg.text: GEN 000 · CONTRIBUTION MAP LOADED — EVERY GREEN SQUARE IS A LIVING CELL
GEN 50 · 50 generations in and the whole board is coupling. Capacitively, inductively, enthusiastically.
GEN 100 · Forward-biased and fully saturated. The datasheet swore this operating region was safe.
GEN 150 · Still multiplying at 150. This stopped being a simulation a while ago — it's a breeder reactor now.
STEADY STATE AT GEN 170 — the survivors formed still lifes and oscillators: technically alive, allergic to change. Like legacy code.
RULE B3/S23 — no relation to the country singer, though both fill a board with hits.
Every green square from my contribution graph is a living cell. Fewer than 2 neighbors: dies of underpopulation — nobody to pair-program with.
More than 3: dies of thermal throttling. Exactly 3: a new cell is born, and we don't ask questions.
The edges wrap, because all good universes are toruses.
SEED 0x2BD256B3 · REFRESHED DAILY · TORUS TOPOLOGY · GENESIS NODE @ WK 36 · THU · SEU EVENTS: 6 · RAD-HARD: NO
